page_title: CAG 1-1 VER | Cagliari v Verona 01/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' The cross into the penalty area from Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
90+3' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) will miss the next game.
90+3' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) for his blatant foul.

90+2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) makes a decision to dribble through the defence towards the goal. He gets inside the box, pulls the trigger, but hits the ball very poorly and it goes yards wide of the target.
90+1' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+1' Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew low towards the middle of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo made a superb athletic save to deny him.
89' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Cagliari was in an offside position.
88' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
86' Daniele Doveri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) and blew his whistle.
85' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karol Swiderski (Verona) replacing Tijjani Noslin.
83' Chance! Michael Folorunsho (Verona) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tommaso Augello walks off the pitch to be replaced by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
81' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
81' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
80' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
80' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
80' The game is interrupted. Juan Cabal (Verona) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
78' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:7.

74' 1 - 1 Goal! Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Lorenzo Montipo is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
74' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
74' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
72' Substitution. Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) has come on for Alessandro Deiola.
72' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Nahitan Nandez and he is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari).
72' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antoine Makoumbou.
71' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
70' Cagliari will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
69' Darko Lazovic (Verona) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
68' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
66' Today's match ends for Federico Bonazzoli who will be replaced by Tomas Suslov (Verona).
64' Cagliari couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
63' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
61' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

61' Darko Lazovic (Verona) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Simone Scuffet anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the middle of the target.
60' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
60' Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
57' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
56' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
55' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
55' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Cagliari earn a corner.
53' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
53' PENALTY APPEAL by Cagliari, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
50' Celebrations are cut short for Verona as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
50' The Verona players halt their celebrations as referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
49' Goal! Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes a short pass from Ondrej Duda in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
48' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Nicolas Viola and Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) is off.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Baroni probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Stefan Mitrovic. He is replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
40' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Simone Scuffet.
40' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
36' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
36' It looks like Michael Folorunsho (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
30' 0 - 1 What a goal! Tijjani Noslin swings a cross into the box and Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 0:1.
29' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
27' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
27' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
26' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
26' Suat Serdar (Verona) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
24' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
21' Ondrej Duda (Verona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
21' Ball possession – 47:53.
18' Stefan Mitrovic (Verona) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
15' Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
14' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
12' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
12' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cagliari for a penalty. Play continues.
10' Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
7' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
4' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
4' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
1' The match has just started.
Verona will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will referee today's match.
